name: Text Generate
description: Writes text with a language model from a prompt, optionally about an image.

inputs.name: system
inputs.label: System prompt
inputs.description: How the model should answer: its role, the form and length of the answer.

inputs.name: image
inputs.label: Image
inputs.description: Read with the prompt, by a model that takes images. Sent at most 1024 pixels on a side.

inputs.name: max_tokens
inputs.label: Longest answer
inputs.description: In tokens. Unset: the model's own limit.

inputs.name: temperature
inputs.label: Temperature
inputs.description: Higher answers more freely. Unset: the model's default.

inputs.name: thinking
inputs.label: Thinking
inputs.description: Let a model that reasons do so before it answers: slower, and it uses up the longest answer.
